algorithm: ECDSA over P-256, P-384 and P-521 (FIPS 186-5)
source: NIST ACVP-Server, https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server commit 975de31eb83d, gen-val/json-files/DetECDSA-SigGen-FIPS186-5 and ECDSA-SigVer-FIPS186-5, converted by scripts/gen_acvp_sig_vectors.py. Every case for the three curves under each hash this library has that is wide enough for the curve. A `sign` case carries the private key from NIST's internal projection and the signature deterministic ECDSA produces; a `verify` case carries NIST's verdict and its reason. Signatures are fixed-width r || s and public keys SEC1 uncompressed.
